winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop Doing X' Warning: Start with an imperative command that addresses a common, painful financial mistake (e.g., 'Stop buying Nifty dips...').
The 'Hidden Loss' Reveal: Highlight a specific, relatable financial product (FDs, Home Loans) and frame it as a secret wealth-killer (e.g., 'Your bank's X is secretly making you poorer...').
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly between 20-22 seconds to maximize loop potential.
Eliminate preamble; start the hook at 0.0s and deliver the core insight within the first 5 seconds.
Use high-contrast visual cues (red/green charts or bold text overlays) every 3 seconds to reset viewer attention.
seo_directives: Use high-intent keywords in the title related to specific asset classes (Nifty, Stocks, FD) rather than generic financial advice.
Limit hashtags to 3-4 high-volume, relevant tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia #PersonalFinance #InvestingTips) to avoid algorithm dilution.
